title: Dash BT connection issues
symptom: Omnipod Dash loses Bluetooth connection after a couple of hours. Restarting Bluetooth, AAPS, and phone, deleting nearby device permissions for other apps, and toggling the BT bond setting in AAPS did not help. User lost 4 pods and issue persists after updating AAPS.
cause: The issue is related to the 'Bond BT device on Android 15+ (Pixel phones workaround)' option being enabled on Android 16, which is not intended for that version.
fix: Disable the 'Bond BT device on Android 15+ (Pixel phones workaround)' option when using Android 16, as it is only for Android 15.
settings_changed: Bond BT device on Android 15+ (Pixel phones workaround) → disabled
evidence_quote: Don‘t enable the „Bond BT device on Android 15+ …“ on Android 16. This option is for Android 15 only.
